prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. This crate computes projectile motion under constant gravity, with angles in degrees. Implement `range`, `max_height` and `time_of_flight` using the standard ideal-projectile equations, and validate inputs first: a negative or non-finite speed returns `Err("speed")`, a non-positive or non-finite gravity returns `Err("gravity")`, and a non-finite angle returns `Err("angle")`. Results are in the same units as the inputs. Keep the public signatures and the existing tests unchanged. Inspect the code, make the smallest correct change, run `cargo test`, and finish only when the tests pass.
